notes: The typed method sends authenticated DELETE /v1/accounts/me as a mutating request and decodes the 202 wipe acknowledgement.
No public raw or managed method implements DELETE /v1/accounts/webhook.
AccountMeResponse omits the OpenAPI and documented message_notify object from the otherwise matching success shape.
The typed method sends authenticated GET /v1/accounts/simulations and decodes the full simulations history response.
The method percent-encodes the required token path segment and decodes VerificationResponse.
No public raw or managed method implements GET /v1/accounts/webhook.
The PATCH method and tri-state fields are present, but AccountUpdateRequest and AccountUpdateResponse both omit the OpenAPI message_notify object.
The method serializes RegisterRequest, sends unauthenticated POST /v1/accounts, and decodes RegisterResponse.
The method serializes the email recovery body, sends unauthenticated POST /v1/accounts/recover, and decodes RecoverResponse.
No public raw or managed method implements POST /v1/accounts/webhook.
AccountInfo models all four AccountInfoSchema properties with matching optional scalar wire types.
AccountMeResponse models the account snapshot fields but omits message_notify.
RegisterResponse models account, message, and nullable verify_url from AccountResponseSchema.
AccountUpdateRequest models the tri-state update fields but omits nullable message_notify.
AccountUpdateResponse models every listed property except message_notify.
AccountWipeRequestedResponse models the message acknowledgement field.
EventSettings models ami_digest_interval and nullable muted fields with matching scalar and array types.
MessageSettings models nullable email and subscribed string-array fields.
RecoverRequest models the required email body field.
RecoverResponse models the human-readable message field.
RegisterRequest models email, name, and nullable timezone with matching serialized names.
ReplicantBrief models replicant_code and name with matching optional string types.
AccountReplicantSummary models all ten documented replicant summary properties and nullable location, star, and host fields.
VerificationResponse models api_token, message, and the nullable typed ReplicantBrief result.
No public response type or endpoint method represents the webhook info schema.

No public response type or endpoint method represents webhook removal.
No public response type or endpoint method represents the webhook registration response.
AccountAchievementListResponse contains the achievements array of six-field AccountAchievement entries.
AchievementDetailResponse models all detail fields and the typed players array.
AchievementIndexResponse contains the typed achievement summary array.
AchievementPlayer models account_name and achieved_at.
AchievementSummary models all seven public catalogue fields including nullable last_achieved_at.
